_doc: #773 THE plan and THE ratchet of the fleet's move to Jetpack Compose, as data. Read by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-compose-ratchet.py (run by compose-ratchet-guard.yml on every push) and explained in a0_docs/eng-specs/compose-migration.md. The script owns the counting rules; this file owns everything else: what makes a class a screen, what marks it Compose, which units are in scope, where a fork's first-party code lives, the migration order, and the BASELINE each unit may not exceed. THE RATCHET: a count above its baseline fails (new UI is written in Compose); a count BELOW its baseline also fails until the baseline is lowered to match, in the same commit as the migration — so progress is recorded the moment it happens and can never silently slide back. A unit not listed here has an implicit baseline of 0 everywhere, so a new app or lib written in Views fails on its first push.
_doc_units: A unit is a top-level directory matching unit_dir_pattern, or one lib under shared_libs_dir (id libs:<dir>). scope=out excludes a vendored or web-wrapper tree from counting, and must say why in `reason`. `roots` (unit-relative, files or directories) narrows a fork to OUR additions; a root that stops existing fails the guard, because counting nothing looks exactly like having migrated everything. `screen_bases` adds a fork's upstream screen base classes, which sit outside its roots. wave = migration order (0 already Compose, 1 shared kit + SuperApp-hosted libs, 2 SuperApp, 3 small View apps, 4 apps that reuse SuperApp pages or are map-centric, 5 IME surfaces). size: S < 1 agent-day, M 1-3, L 3-7, XL > 7.
_doc_metrics: view_screens: classes extending a screen base (directly or through a class in the same unit) whose file still builds Views, or that set a content view and host no Compose. layout_xml: res/layout*/*.xml. view_ui_files: source files that build or inflate Views. custom_views: classes extending a View type (AbstractComposeView excluded). Tests, build output and declared upstream trees never count.
_doc_rules: view_builder_marker_ambiguous names widgets that are ALSO Compose functions (Button, Switch, Chip); they count only in a file with no @Composable in it. There is deliberately no list of Compose base classes: a screen counts only when its own file builds Views or sets a content view, so a KitComposeFragment subclass (whose file holds nothing but composables) never counts without being named anywhere.
